---
title: "Topic: Innovation"
---

*Use at baseline and endline. Drawn from the Community Innovation Survey (CIS), the standard EU instrument for measuring firm-level innovation.*

---

### Product Innovation

**A product innovation is a new or improved good or service that differs significantly from the firm’s previous goods or services and which has been implemented on the market.

Include:
- significant changes to the design of a good
- digital goods or services


**During the last three years, did your company introduce any new or significantly improved goods?**
- Yes
- No

**If yes: How many?**
*(Open numeric field)*

**During the last [number] years, did your company introduce any new or significantly improved services?**
- Yes
- No

**If yes: How many?**
*(Open numeric field)*

**Since [year], did your enterprise introduce any new or improved products (goods or services) that were:**
- Not previously offered by any of your competitors
- Identical or very similar to products already offered by your competitors
- None of the above

**Who developed these product innovations?**
**(Select all that apply)*
- Your enterprise by itself
- Your enterprise together with other enterprises or organisations*
- Your enterprise by adapting or modifying products originally developed by other enterprises or organisations*
- Other enterprises or organisations*

**What share of your company's total turnover in the last financial year came from goods or services that were new or significantly improved in the last three years?**
- None
- Less than 5%
- 5–19%
- 20–49%
- 50% or more


### Process Innovation

A business process innovation is a new or improved business process for one or more business functions that differs significantly from the firm’s previous business processes and which has been implemented within the firm.

**During the last three years, did your company introduce any new or significantly improved processes?**
- Yes
- No

**If yes: How many?**
*(Open numeric field)*

**Since 2024, did your enterprise introduce any of the following types of new or improved processes that differ significantly from your previous processes?**
*(Select all that apply)*
- Methods for producing goods or providing services (including methods for developing goods or services)
- Logistics, delivery or distribution methods 
- Methods for information processing or communication
- Methods for accounting or other administrative operations
- Business practices for organising procedures or external relations
- Methods of organising work responsibility, decision making or human resource management
- Marketing methods for promotion, packaging, pricing, product placement or after sales services
- None of the above

**Who developed these process innovations?**
*(Select all that apply)*
- Your enterprise by itself
- Your enterprise together with other enterprises or organisations
- Your enterprise by adapting or modifying processes originally developed by other enterprises or organisations
- Other enterprises or organisations


### Innovation activities

'Innovation activity' includes all developmental, financial and commercial activities, undertaken by a firm, which are intended to or result in an innovation.
Research and Development (R&D): R&D comprise creative and systematic work undertaken in order to increase the stock of knowledge – including knowledge of humankind, culture and society – and to devise new applications of available knowledge.
R&D Performed in-house: R&D undertaken by your enterprise to create new knowledge or solve scientific or technical problems. Include current expenditures including labour costs and capital expenditures on buildings and equipment specifically for R&D)
R&D contracted out:  Your enterprise contracted-out R&D to other enterprises (include enterprises in your own group) or to public or private research organisations.

**Since [year], has your enterprise had any of the following types of innovation activities? (Activities leading to expenditures)**

- Completed activities on product or process innovation
- Ongoing innovation activities at the end of 2025
- Abandoned innovation activities
- In-house research and development activities
- Contract-out R&D to other enterprises (include enterprises in your own group) or to public or private research organisations
- None of the above



**During [year], did your company have expenditure on the following innovation-related activities?**
*(Select all that apply and provide approximate amounts in €)*
- In-house R&D
- External R&D (contracted out)
- Acquisition of machinery, equipment, or software for innovation
- Acquisition of external knowledge (e.g. patents, licences)
- Training for innovation activities
- Market introduction of innovations (e.g. market research, advertising)
- Design and other creative work

*Source: CIS. Use at: Baseline and endline.*
